studyMetadata.title: AI Attribution Study
studyMetadata.description: Understand how students engage with large language-model (LLM) coding tools and to assess the tools' effectiveness in supporting the learning process.
organizations: Department of Computer Science, University of Toronto

Prior to university, how would you rate your programming experience?
options: None: I have never seen or written computer code.
Novice: I have seen code or used a tutorial (e.g., Codecademy, Hour of Code) but never written a program on my own.
Basic: I have written simple programs (e.g., for a high school class or hobby) but do not feel confident.
Intermediate: I am comfortable writing programs of moderate complexity (e.g., AP CS A level).
Advanced: I have extensive experience (e.g., paid work, released apps, or competition programming).
